tasks.short: Consult institutions about emergency needs and capabilities

steps.what: Retrieve and check actual institution contacts, prior capability records and current consultation questions
inputs: OPS_SYSTEM: existing emergency planning and capability register
Actual government, school, hospital and institution contacts
Actual current consultation scope
outputs: Checked consultation context and unresolved capability questions

steps.what: Consult actual local and area officials and institutional representatives to determine emergency needs and capabilities
inputs: Checked consultation questions
Representatives' actual accounts and supporting evidence
outputs: Actual stated needs, capabilities, limits and unresolved confirmations

steps.what: Capture the actual capability findings in the existing planning record and check the entire final entry
inputs: Actual consultation findings and evidence
Required capability-record fields
outputs: Complete checked final capability entry with unconfirmed claims marked

steps.what: Save the exact checked capability entry in the existing planning register
inputs: Exact final entry checked in s3
outputs: Saved actual capability record

tasks.design: Configure native {OPS_SYSTEM} institution views and capability-record fields, with the actual consultation questions in {DOCS}. The director consults representatives, captures actual findings and checks the complete final capability entry before saving it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding prior capability context and repeating record headings adds handling around actual consultation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native planning-register views and forms can reuse existing context and entry structure.
tasks.still_hard: Actual readiness, capability limits and credible commitments require representatives and evidence.
tasks.human_edge: The director distinguishes an institution's stated capacity from a confirmed operational capability.

ambition.what: Reduce handling around existing capability consultation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: planning-register views and native fields can reduce retrieval and repeated record structure while officials confirm actual needs and capabilities.

assumptions: Unmeasured consultation episode with an actual existing capability-record update; not a report invented after every informal conversation. Shares are independent of the prompt prior.

Institutional representatives supply actual capability statements and evidence. s1 counts context retrieval and checking, s2 actual consultation and s3 actual capture, uncertainty marking and complete final checking. No clean capability feed is assumed free.
Use native views and forms first; equivalent existing capabilities earn no new benefit. No staffing promise, resource reservation, operational order or external notification is hidden in the save.
Same-system saving is immediate with no saving. Changed findings require renewed final checking. Gross 5.85 minus 1.5 upkeep gives 4.35 net per 100 focal baseline hours.
unknowns: Actual register requirements and retrieval effort
research_questions: Which capability fields are actually repeated in the current register?

already_counted.description: Retained context retrieval and actual capability capture and complete checking

incremental.description: Maintain current institution views and capability-entry fields

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete capability entry and uncertainty status checked in s3; changed findings require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 2.25 retrieval plus 3.6 record-handling = 5.85 gross, minus 1.5 upkeep = 4.35 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain emergency planning and response liaisons

steps.what: Locate and check actual municipality and department liaison contacts, responsibilities and prior agreements
inputs: OPS_SYSTEM: existing emergency liaison register
Actual contact and responsibility records
Current relevant agreements
outputs: Checked current liaison context and contact gaps

steps.what: Develop and maintain actual liaisons to facilitate plans, response coordination and potential personnel or equipment exchanges
inputs: Checked liaison context
Actual partner needs, constraints and responsibilities
outputs: Actual liaison understanding and confirmed or pending coordination points

steps.what: Update and check the actual liaison contact and responsibility entry from confirmed partner information
inputs: Actual confirmed partner contacts and responsibilities
Pending coordination points from s2
outputs: Complete checked final liaison entry

steps.what: Save the exact checked liaison entry
inputs: Exact final liaison entry checked in s3
outputs: Saved current liaison record

tasks.design: Configure current liaison views and native contact fields in {OPS_SYSTEM}, with actual agreements linked from {DOCS}. Keep relationship work and partner confirmation with the director, then check and save the actual final liaison entry.
tasks.previous_blocker: Searching contacts and repeating liaison fields adds handling to relationship maintenance.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and contact forms can reuse existing confirmed information.
tasks.still_hard: Trust, partner constraints and workable mutual arrangements require actual relationships.
tasks.human_edge: The director understands who can actually help and how coordination should work.

ambition.what: Reduce record handling around current liaison work.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 for partner-contact and register access consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native liaison views and contact fields can reduce record retrieval and repeated entry while relationship maintenance stays human.

assumptions: Unmeasured liaison episode with an actual contact/responsibility update; shares are independent of the prompt prior. No new post-call report is assumed.

Partners supply actual contacts and responsibilities. s1 counts retrieval and verification, s2 the actual liaison work and s3 confirmed-data capture and complete final checking. Unconfirmed commitments remain pending.

No personnel deployment, equipment transfer, interagency agreement signature or operational order is hidden in this liaison-record save. Actual exchanges require their own authorized actions. Native forms come first and existing equivalent views earn no additional saving.

Same-system saving is immediate with no saving. If this liaison update is the same capability consultation recorded under task 7263, count shared source and record handling once. Gross 5.4 minus 1.5 upkeep gives 3.9 net per 100 focal baseline hours.
unknowns: Actual contact upkeep effort and overlap with capability consultations
research_questions: Which contact facts are repeatedly entered today?

already_counted.description: Retained contact verification and actual liaison-entry capture and checking

incremental.description: Maintain current liaison views and contact-field structure

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete liaison entry checked in s3; changed contacts or responsibilities require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 4 retrieval plus 1.4 entry-structure hours = 5.4 gross, minus 1.5 upkeep = 3.9 net.

tasks.short: Coordinate actual disaster response or crisis management

steps.what: Receive and verify actual incident updates, resource status and applicable current emergency plans
inputs: OPS_SYSTEM: existing incident command and resource-status system
Actual responder updates and resource confirmations
Current authorized emergency plans
outputs: Checked current incident picture with uncertainties and stale updates marked

steps.what: Coordinate with actual response partners about needs, constraints and provisional response options
inputs: Checked incident picture
Actual partner needs, capacity and constraints
outputs: Actual coordinated response options and unresolved conflicts

steps.what: Decide the actual authorized response action, such as a public-shelter opening, from the current situation
inputs: Actual response options and current verified status
Applicable plan and actual delegated authority
outputs: Director's actual response decision and limits

steps.what: Prepare and check the complete final response order, target, timing, recipients and actual authority
inputs: Actual response decision
Current checked incident status
Actual recipient contacts and delegated authority
outputs: Exact final checked response order and recipients

steps.what: Issue the exact checked response order to the actual response recipients
inputs: Exact final order and recipients checked in s4
outputs: Issued authorized response order

steps.what: Monitor actual acknowledgments and response progress, capture the incident entry and check its complete final content
inputs: Issued order
Actual recipient acknowledgments and response updates
outputs: Actual monitored response and complete checked incident entry

steps.what: Save the exact checked incident entry in the existing command record
inputs: Exact final incident entry checked in s6
outputs: Saved actual response and acknowledgment record

tasks.design: Configure the existing {OPS_SYSTEM} status view and links to actual {DOCS} emergency plans to reduce repeated navigation. Keep verification, coordination, response decisions, final order checking, issuance and monitoring with the director; record the actual incident entry separately.
tasks.previous_blocker: Navigating scattered current status screens adds handling during actual response coordination.
tasks.enabler_now: Native incident-system views can expose existing current updates without selecting response actions.
tasks.still_hard: Uncertain incidents, response consequences and actual operational authority require the responsible people.
tasks.human_edge: The director judges the actual situation and owns every response decision.

ambition.what: Reduce minor status navigation in existing human-directed response.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native incident-status views can reduce navigation while response decisions and operational orders remain human controlled.

assumptions: Unmeasured authorized shelter-response coordination episode, not an invented universal mix of evacuations, shelter openings and special-needs programs. Shares are independent of the prompt prior. No operational instructions or response plan are generated by this proposal.

Responders and resource owners produce actual updates; s1 counts receipt, freshness and identity verification. Missing or stale facts remain explicit. The native view saves navigation only, not collection, analysis or confirmation effort.

s2 is provisional coordination; s3 the actual decision. This episode assumes the director's real delegated authority. A decision reserved to another official must receive that person's review of the complete final order before issuance, with their labor added.

s4 prepares and checks the complete exact order before s5 issues it. New facts, changed content or recipients require renewed checking before each issue. s6 counts actual monitoring and incident-record capture; s7 separately saves its checked final entry. Neither immediate action earns a saving.

No automatic evacuation, shelter activation, personnel dispatch or special-needs decision is proposed. Physical response execution remains responders' existing work. Detailed situation-report preparation belongs to task 7260 and is not silently included or counted twice.
Existing equivalent status views earn no extra gain. Gross 2 minus 1 upkeep gives 1 net per 100 focal baseline hours.
unknowns: Actual order authority and recipient channels
research_questions: Does the existing incident view already provide the needed current status?

already_counted.description: Retained status verification, response decision, complete order checking, monitoring and incident capture

incremental.description: Maintain current-status view links and verify them after incident-system changes

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete response order and recipients checked in s4 within actual delegated authority; new facts or changes require renewed checking
Exact complete incident entry checked in s6; changed response or acknowledgment content requires renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 20 times 10% = 2 navigation hours gross, minus 1 upkeep = 1 net. Operational response work is retained in full.

steps.what: Collect and verify actual response, recovery, needs and preliminary damage updates for the reporting cutoff
inputs: OPS_SYSTEM: existing incident and recovery register
Responders' actual time-stamped updates
Actual preliminary damage and needs assessments
outputs: Checked reporting sources with cutoff, uncertainty and conflicting updates identified

steps.what: Stage the actual checked update fields into the situation-report template using exact incident and source identifiers
inputs: Checked update sources from s1
Explicit field, incident and source-identifier mappings
outputs: Staged report fields and unmatched or missing inputs

steps.what: Compile exact reported counts and status tables using the actual cutoff and category rules
inputs: Staged actual update fields
Declared cutoff, status and category rules
outputs: Draft status tables with duplicate or conflicting update flags

steps.what: Write and edit the actual status narrative describing response, recovery, needs and preliminary damage
inputs: Checked sources and compiled tables
Director's actual interpretation and documented unresolved issues
outputs: Complete draft situation report with source-linked claims

loop.purpose: Draft descriptive situation-report prose from actual updates
loop.input: Checked sources, tables and director-authored explanations
loop.output: Draft narrative preserving cutoff, uncertainty and source identifiers
loop.check: Director checks every factual claim and edits against actual sources
loop.stop: Unsupported claim, missing source, stale update or altered certainty requires manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Describing actual developments requires semantic synthesis beyond exact table fields

steps.what: Resolve duplicate and conflicting updates and check the complete final report against all accepted sources
inputs: Complete draft report and flagged inputs
Original accepted sources
Actual cutoff and preliminary assessment status
outputs: Complete checked final situation report with honest uncertainty and review status

steps.what: Save the exact checked final situation report in the existing incident document record
inputs: Exact final report checked in s5
outputs: Saved prepared situation report

tasks.design: Configure native {OPS_SYSTEM} field staging and {SPREADSHEET} report tables, then bound the {DOCS} narrative draft to actual accepted updates and the director's explanations. The director resolves conflicts and checks the complete final situation report before saving it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated update transfer, table compilation and narrative redrafting add effort to situation reporting.
tasks.enabler_now: Native mappings and exact reporting rules can compile actual facts; a bounded draft can describe checked developments.
tasks.still_hard: Source reliability, conflicting reports and preliminary damage uncertainty require the director's judgment.
tasks.human_edge: The director distinguishes confirmed observations, provisional estimates and unresolved needs.

ambition.what: Prepare updated situation reports when actual accepted updates materially change.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact incident-field mappings and reporting rules can assemble status tables, and bounded drafting can express supplied facts subject to full source checking.

assumptions: Unmeasured actual report-preparation episode; shares are independent of the prompt prior.

Responders and assessment teams produce actual updates through existing work. s1 counts the director's collection, capture of mapped fields, cutoff checks and verification. No free clean incident feed or invented damage estimate is assumed.

s2 and s3 are distinct explicit proposed machine actions. Missing or conflicting fields remain flagged for manual resolution in s5, not silently imputed or treated as zero. s4 counts actual interpretation authorship and source-linked editing; preliminary findings retain their uncertainty.
Use native report capabilities first; equivalent existing imports and tables are baseline and earn no new benefit. No response decision, emergency order or automatic escalation is generated.

s5 checks the complete final report. s6 only saves the prepared report with its actual review status; no internal distribution, external publication or official notification is hidden. Any required release approval occurs on the complete final version. Same-system save earns no saving.
If source updates are already collected in task 7257 for the same reporting cutoff, count shared collection once. Gross 47 minus 4 upkeep gives 43 net per 100 focal baseline hours.
unknowns: Current field transfers and report templates
Actual source update consistency and reporting cutoff rules
research_questions: Which report fields are still copied by hand?
How are superseded or duplicate updates identified today?

already_counted.description: Retained source capture, narrative interpretation and editing, conflict resolution and complete final checking

incremental.description: Maintain source mappings, cutoff rules and permitted drafting context and test changed update formats

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete situation report with cutoff and uncertainty checked in s5; changed facts or wording require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 25 update staging plus 15 table handling plus 7 narrative handling = 47 gross, minus 4 upkeep = 43 net. Existing equivalent incident reporting reduces additional benefits.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
